accredited-investor.title: Accredited Investor
accredited-investor.description: An individual or entity meeting SEC financial thresholds ($200K+ annual income or $1M+ net worth) that qualifies to invest in unregistered securities offerings.

aml.title: AML (Anti-Money Laundering)
aml.description: Laws, regulations, and procedures designed to prevent criminals from disguising illegally obtained funds as legitimate income through financial transactions.

atomic-settlement.title: Atomic Settlement
atomic-settlement.description: A transaction mechanism where all parts of a trade execute simultaneously and completely.

bankable.title: Bankable
bankable.description: Securities in a format recognized by traditional banking infrastructure — CrossSecurities can CrossConvert to bankable ISIN form held via Clearstream.

bloom.title: BLOOM_FINAL / The Application Engine
bloom.description: The application engine layer of Sails.to, built on Sandstorm/Melusina OS, providing the grain runtime for all platform applications.

broker-dealer.title: Broker-Dealer
broker-dealer.description: Licensed securities professional who can execute trades and place investors in CrossSecurities offerings through our network.

brokerage-fee.title: Brokerage Fee
brokerage-fee.description: A fee charged by a broker for executing securities transactions on behalf of clients, typically calculated as a percentage of the transaction value.

cap-n-proto.title: Cap'n Proto
cap-n-proto.description: A zero-copy serialization protocol used for inter-grain RPC in the Sails.to platform, eliminating encoding/decoding overhead entirely.

cap-table.title: Cap Table (Capitalization Table)
cap-table.description: A complete record of a company's securities ownership, showing all shareholders, their holdings, and ownership percentages, updated in real-time on blockchain.

clearstream.title: Clearstream
clearstream.description: A major international securities depository and settlement system based in Luxembourg, enabling custody and settlement of securities across 110+ markets.

commission.title: Commission
commission.description: Fees paid to brokers and introducers for placing investors or facilitating trades — typically a percentage of the investment or transaction value.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal requirements — automated and enforced on-chain for CrossSecurities through KYC/AML, investor eligibility.

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.description: The periodic interest payment made to bondholders, typically expressed as an annual percentage of the bond's nominal value.

crossconversion-series.title: CrossConversion Series
crossconversion-series.description: A dedicated series within a Series LLC structure that facilitates the conversion of securities between on-chain tokens and bankable ISIN format.

crossconversion.title: CrossConversion
crossconversion.description: The process of moving Sails CrossSecurities between on-chain (Solana) and bankable (ISIN/Clearstream) forms while maintaining 1:1 backing.

crosssecurities.title: CrossSecurities
crosssecurities.description: Sails CrossSecurities are bonds, shares, or RWA tokens that can be held on-chain (Solana) or via traditional bank/brokerage custody (ISIN-bearing) — and.

custody.title: Custody
custody.description: The safekeeping and administration of securities on behalf of investors, including settlement, corporate actions processing, and record-keeping.

distribution-fee.title: Distribution Fee
distribution-fee.description: A fee charged by the platform to distribute securities tokens to investors during an offering, covering tokenization and delivery costs.

distributions.title: Distributions
distributions.description: Payments made to security token holders, including dividends, interest, rental income, or liquidation proceeds, automated via smart contracts.

escrow.title: Escrow
escrow.description: A neutral holding arrangement where funds are held by a trusted third party until predetermined conditions are met, protecting both buyers and sellers.

grain.title: Grain
grain.description: The fundamental isolation unit in Sandstorm/Melusina OS — a sandboxed application instance with its own journal store, capabilities, and lifecycle.

hard-cap.title: Hard Cap
hard-cap.description: The maximum amount of capital an issuer will accept in a securities offering. Once reached, no additional investments are accepted.

investor-verification.title: Investor Verification
investor-verification.description: The process of confirming an investor's identity, financial status, and eligibility to participate in private securities offerings.

isin.title: ISIN (International Securities Identification Number)
isin.description: A 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a security globally, enabling it to be held in traditional bank custody systems.

kyc.title: KYC (Know Your Customer)
kyc.description: Regulatory process to verify the identity of clients, assess their suitability.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.description: The ease of buying or selling a security without significantly affecting its price — provided for CrossSecurities through our multi-broker OTC network.

management-fee.title: Management Fee
management-fee.description: An ongoing fee charged for the administration and management of a securities offering. Sails.

master-nft.title: Master NFT
master-nft.description: The root authority token in Sails.to's 4-layer NFT hierarchy on Solana, controlled by 3-of-5 keyholder threshold signing.

maturity.title: Maturity
maturity.description: The date on which a bond's principal amount becomes due and payable to the bondholder, marking the end of the bond's term.

melusina.title: Melusina
melusina.description: The on-chain authority layer for Sails.to — a Solana-based system implementing NFT hierarchies, KYC credentialing, SPL-2022 compliance tokens.

minimum-investment.title: Minimum Investment
minimum-investment.description: $150,000 minimum investment threshold for CrossSecurities — set to comply with professional and accredited investor regulations globally.

nft-hierarchy.title: NFT Hierarchy
nft-hierarchy.description: Sails.to's 4-layer authority structure on Solana: Master NFT → Reseller NFT → License NFT (pNFT) → Share NFT, ensuring cryptographic chain of trust.

nominal-value.title: Nominal Value
nominal-value.description: The face value of a security as stated by the issuer, representing the principal amount for bonds or the stated value per share for equity.

offering-memorandum.title: Offering Memorandum
offering-memorandum.description: Legal document detailing investment terms, risks, use of proceeds, and issuer information — required for all CrossSecurities offerings on Sails.to.

offering.title: Offering
offering.description: A structured securities fundraise on Sails.to, governed by an Offering Grain with its own token supply, compliance configuration, and distribution waterfall.

on-chain.title: On-Chain
on-chain.description: Recorded directly on a blockchain — CrossSecurities exist on-chain on Solana with ownership, transfers, and compliance enforced by smart contracts.

operating-series.title: Operating Series
operating-series.description: A dedicated series within a Series LLC structure that holds an issuer's specific project assets and liabilities, isolated from other series.

operational-trust.title: Operational Trust
operational-trust.description: A trust structure used to hold and manage operational assets on behalf of investors, providing fiduciary oversight and legal protection.

otc.title: OTC (Over-the-Counter)
otc.description: Securities trading conducted directly between two parties without a centralized exchange, often used for larger transactions or less liquid securities.

paying-agent.title: Paying Agent
paying-agent.description: The entity authorized to execute distributions and manage the revenue waterfall for a Sails.to offering, operating under Trustee oversight.

pda.title: PDA (Program Derived Address)
pda.description: A deterministic Solana account address derived from program seeds, used in Sails.to for trustless, programmatic state management.

powerbox.title: Powerbox
powerbox.description: The inter-grain capability sharing mechanism in Sandstorm/Melusina OS, enabling secure permission delegation via claim tokens and persistent sturdyRefs.

private-placement.title: Private Placement
private-placement.description: Sale of securities directly to qualified investors without public offering registration — the primary method for issuing CrossSecurities on Sails.to.

professional-investor.title: Professional Investor
professional-investor.description: Under EU/international regulations, an investor with sufficient experience, knowledge, and expertise to make independent investment decisions and assess risks.

reg-d.title: Regulation D (Reg D)
reg-d.description: SEC regulation providing exemptions from registration for private placements, allowing companies to raise capital from accredited investors without a.

reg-s.title: Regulation S (Reg S)
reg-s.description: SEC regulation providing a safe harbor for securities offerings made outside the United States to non-US persons, exempt from SEC registration requirements.

sandstorm.title: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: An open-source platform for self-hosting web applications, providing OS-level isolation for each application instance (grain) in the Sails.to runtime.

secondary-trading.title: Secondary Trading
secondary-trading.description: The buying and selling of securities after their initial issuance, providing liquidity and price discovery for investors seeking to exit positions.

security-deposit.title: Security Deposit
security-deposit.description: An upfront payment required from issuers to initiate the onboarding process and cover preliminary legal, compliance, and structuring costs.

security-token.title: Security Token
security-token.description: A digital representation of a traditional security (equity, debt, or fund share) issued on a blockchain with built-in compliance rules enforced by smart.

series-llc.title: Series LLC
series-llc.description: A corporate structure allowing a single LLC to create multiple segregated series, each with its own assets, liabilities, and members.

smart-contract.title: Smart Contract
smart-contract.description: Self-executing code deployed on a blockchain that automatically enforces the terms of an agreement when predetermined conditions are met.

soft-cap.title: Soft Cap
soft-cap.description: The minimum funding threshold an offering must reach for the capital raise to proceed. If the soft cap is not met, investor funds are typically returned.

solana.title: Solana
solana.description: A high-performance blockchain platform known for fast transaction speeds (400ms finality) and low fees, used by Sails.to for issuing CrossSecurities.

spv.title: SPV (Special Purpose Vehicle)
spv.description: A subsidiary entity created for a specific, limited purpose, typically to isolate financial risk and hold specific assets separate from a parent company.

threshold-signing.title: Threshold Signing
threshold-signing.description: M-of-N keyholder cryptographic operations used to protect critical Sails.to platform actions, implementing distributed authority on Solana.

tokenization.title: Tokenization
tokenization.description: The process of converting ownership rights in an asset into digital tokens on a blockchain, enabling fractional ownership and programmable compliance.

tradfi-bridge.title: TradFi Bridge (CrossConversion)
tradfi-bridge.description: Also known as CrossConversion — Sails.to's mechanism for converting on-chain CrossSecurities to bankable ISIN securities that can be held in conventional.

transfer-hook.title: Transfer Hook
transfer-hook.description: A Solana SPL-2022 extension that intercepts token transfers and enforces compliance rules before allowing any transfer to proceed.

treasury-series.title: Treasury Series
treasury-series.description: A dedicated series within a Series LLC structure that holds un-issued or repurchased tokens, managing the supply of securities.

trustee.title: Trustee
trustee.description: An independent fiduciary entity that represents and protects the interests of bondholders or investors, ensuring issuers meet their obligations.

vienna-mtf.title: Vienna MTF
vienna-mtf.description: A regulated Multilateral Trading Facility operated by the Vienna Stock Exchange group.

waterfall.title: Waterfall
waterfall.description: The revenue distribution priority structure for Sails.to offerings, enforcing investor-first payment order on-chain via smart contracts.

white-label.title: White-Label
white-label.description: Branded platform instances available to regulated institutions, trust companies, and broker-dealers, with custom theming and compliance configuration.

wyoming-dao-llc.title: Wyoming DAO Series LLC
wyoming-dao-llc.description: Wyoming's legally-recognized DAO structure combined with Series LLC capability — each Sails.
